name: visual-architect
title_zh: 先画语义再落笔的架构图生成器
tagline_zh: 画架构图最怕改一处全盘重来。它先逼你把组件、关系、约束说清楚，再生成自包含 HTML+SVG，评审、演进。
tagline_en: Tired of redrawing diagrams when requirements shift? It forces you to define components, relations, and.
desc_en: Create, validate, review, and evolve professional technical diagrams as self-contained HTML + SVG. Use for software/system architecture, cloud and infrastructure, flowcharts, sequences, ER/data models, database schemas, deployment views, data flows, process/swimlane diagrams, state machines, dependency graphs, user journeys, timelines, and technical explanations. Model semantics before drawing, ch
why_zh: 语义先行，图是投影。改需求时改模型而非挪方块，图自动一致。产物是单文件，不依赖在线服务，能进仓库。
why_en: Model first, drawing is just a projection. Change the model, not the boxes; the diagram stays consistent. Output is one portable.
limit_zh: 只认技术类图示（架构/流程/ER/状态机等），不画插画、UI 稿、数据可视化大屏。输入得是结构化描述。
limit_en: Technical diagrams only (architecture/flow/ER/state, etc.). No illustrations, UI mockups, or dashboards. Needs structured input; long free-text.
